subject: world_language
concept: Reading an authentic short literary text in the target language without simplification
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR C1 'understand a wide range of demanding texts' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student follows along with vocabulary support while reading an authentic short literary excerpt
exercise.abstract: Student answers comprehension and light interpretive questions about an authentic literary text

misconception_flags: relies entirely on cognates or surface familiarity rather than genuine comprehension of the authentic text

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
